svg.title: Ready for agents: the framework ships rules and job plans for Claude Code and Cursor, and UmeSync's MCP server shows them projects, instances and selene, StyLua and ume-lsp checks

g.text: Claude Code and Cursor find their way
around a ume game. The framework ships its
rules and job plans for both, and UmeSync's
MCP server shows them your projects, the
instances they build and what selene,
StyLua and ume-lsp make of the code.
MCP is served on 127.0.0.1, to this computer only.

text.tspan: Reads the ume rules, then every script in Shop.
